hooks.name: Check Cozy interaction rules
hooks.description: Reviews Cozy defaults, copy, text size, and Reduce Motion.

action.prompt: Review the saved UI file against `.kiro/steering/cozy-design.md`. Warn with exact file and line for Cozy flicker/lightning/pumpkins, text below 18 pt, alarming copy, decoration-only motion, or movement without a Reduce Motion alternative. Make no unrelated edits.
